verses.pali: “Akusalarāsīti, bhikkhave, vadamāno pañca nīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, rightly speaking, you’d call the five hindrances a ‘heap of the unskillful’.

verses.pali: Kevalo hāyaṁ, bhikkhave, akusalarāsi yadidaṁ pañca nīvaraṇā.
verses.english: For these five hindrances are entirely a heap of the unskillful.
The hindrances of sensual desire, ill will, dullness and drowsiness, restlessness and remorse, and doubt.

verses.pali: Akusalarāsīti, bhikkhave, vadamāno ime pañca nīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
verses.english: Rightly speaking, you’d call these five hindrances a ‘heap of the unskillful’.

verses.pali: Kevalo hāyaṁ, bhikkhave, akusalarāsi yadidaṁ pañca nīvaraṇā”ti.
verses.english: For these five hindrances are entirely a heap of the unskillful.”
